_doc: E2 worked-example fixture - FROZEN, READ-ONLY oracle. Pins the E2 tie-break expected origins for the assessment.py/fault_report rewrite (MASTER-SPEC v7 §3,§6.3,§6.4,§11, build F3). Generated deterministically by an OUT-OF-TREE builder (scratchpad build_e2.py, NOT shipped in the repo) then FROZEN + hash-pinned by the §10 gate; once pinned a build phase MUST NOT regenerate or edit it (the §10 hash check + out-of-tree builder enforce this). Loader contract: IGNORE keys beginning with '_'; consume only registry/records/outcomes; hold `expected` OUT-OF-BAND (feed the impl only registry+records+outcomes, compare its output to `expected`).
_scope: Exercises the POST-VERIFICATION causal-selector + two-feature attribution sub-function ONLY. Cryptographic verification (identity.verify/verify_chain) is OUT OF SCOPE here (signatures/DER are deterministic placeholders); a test treats crypto as pre-verified. The verify-before-attribute crypto path + the wrong-key tamper case are the SEPARATE tamper fixture (build F4).
_purpose: THREE scored outcomes (all false_preemption) with a NON-MONOTONE id->causal-seq permutation, plus a distractor decision. Origins: two attacker-key (signed uncorroborated phantoms; one with an attacker SELF-sighting) and one sensor-fed-spoof (keyless lone sighting). Because 3 outcomes map to causal seqs in a non-monotone order (o1->8 mid, o2->10 max, o3->4 min) AND a distractor sits among the decisions, NO positional/index/zip/sort-by-id(asc or desc)/drop-extreme/drop-middle scheme recovers the mapping - ONLY an ev_id-matched causal selector (covering message AND sighting inputs, §6.3) + the §2/§3 TWO-FEATURE partition (signing-key-count AND recomputed-independent-corroboration) passes all three. See _discrimination.

_consume.causal_selector: per outcome, select the causal decision by walking driving_input_seqs -> input record -> its ev id == outcome.ev_id, where ev id = signed_payload.payload.ev_claim.ev_id for a message input OR ev_id for a sighting input (§6.3). NOT by recency/junction/seq/index/order/input-count/timestamp.
_consume.attribution_rule: over the causal decision's driving_input_seqs compute BOTH features: (a) signing-key-count = distinct non-null signing keys; (b) independent-corroboration count = signed inputs whose key differs from the claimer's key (a self-sighting under the claimer's own key does NOT count). key-count==0 -> keyless-lone-sighting -> sensor-fed-spoof; key-count>=1 AND indep-corrob==0 -> uncorroborated-signed -> attacker-key (attributed to the claimer key); key-count>=1 AND indep-corrob>=1 (>=2 keys) -> corroborated -> legitimate.
_consume.keyless_input: a KEYLESS local sensor reading is a kind:'sighting' with sighter_key=null and signature=null (§11); NOT missing_metadata - it is a recognised input with signing-key-count 0 -> sensor-fed-spoof (§6.4). Its driving_input_seqs pair is [seq, null].
_consume.origin_is_class_independent: origin is decided ONLY from verified provenance (key-count + recomputed corroboration + ev_id link); NOT from the runtime `classification` field, the `outcome.type`, nor the claimer's entity-class.
_consume.clocks: signed_payload.t / sighting.t = logical (100-105); decision.t = sim (150); outcome.t = harm-detection sim (160, after all decisions).
_consume.scored_origins: the 3 provenance-decidable classes (§2/§3): keyless-lone-sighting->sensor-fed-spoof, uncorroborated-signed->attacker-key, corroborated->legitimate. This fixture asserts sensor-fed-spoof (o1) + attacker-key (o2, o3); all three false_preemption so outcome.type carries NO origin signal.

records._note: attacker SELF-sighting for EV-PH1 (same key att-fpr; distinct kind from seq2, no B5-nonce collision; tests independence recompute -> NOT independent)
D_ATT1 (causal for o3): key-count 1, indep-corrob 0 -> attacker-key. MIN decision seq.
D_DISTRACTOR (no outcome matches EV-OTHER): among the decision seqs. Only ev_id marks it as the distractor.
KEYLESS local sensor reading (sighter_key/signature null) for EV-KL -> signing-key-count 0
D_KEYLESS (causal for o1): key-count 0 -> keyless-lone-sighting -> sensor-fed-spoof. MID decision seq.
attacker phantom advance-claim #2 (EV-PH2, distinct ev_id/approach from EV-PH1)
D_ATT2 (causal for o2): key-count 1, indep-corrob 0 -> attacker-key. MAX decision seq.

outcomes._note: causal seq4 (MIN) -> attacker-key. id-order [o1,o2,o3] -> causal seqs [8,10,4] = NON-MONOTONE (mid,max,min): no ascending or descending positional map recovers it.

expected.rationale: o1.ev_id EV-KL matches the KEYLESS sighting seq7 driving decision seq8; sighter_key null -> signing-key-count 0 -> sensor-fed-spoof, culprit null. A rule that ignores key-count (counts only corroboration, which is 0) wrongly returns attacker-key here.
o2.ev_id EV-PH2 matches message seq9 driving decision seq10; key-count 1, indep-corrob 0 -> attacker-key, attributed to att-fpr.

o3.ev_id EV-PH1 matches message seq2 + self-sighting seq3 driving decision seq4; key-count 1, indep-corrob 0 (the self-sighting shares the claimer key so does NOT count) -> attacker-key, attributed to att-fpr. Counting the self-sighting as corroboration wrongly flips this off attacker-key.

_discrimination.correct_map: o1->seq8 (sensor-fed-spoof), o2->seq10 (attacker-key), o3->seq4 (attacker-key). id-order [o1,o2,o3] -> causal-seq [8,10,4] = NON-MONOTONE (mid,max,min).
kills: sort-by-id-asc + map to seq-asc positions -> o1:4/o2:8(or 10)/o3:10: WRONG (correct is 8/10/4)
sort-by-id-asc + map to seq-DESC positions -> o1:10/o2:8/o3:4: WRONG (correct is 8/10/4) - the non-monotone permutation defeats BOTH orderings
positional zip(file order [o1,o2,o3], decisions seq order [4,6,8,10]) -> mispairs (incl. the distractor seq6)
drop-any-single-decision-as-distractor by position -> only ev_id (EV-OTHER matches no outcome) identifies seq6 as the distractor
latest/highest-seq -> seq10: right o2 only; earliest/lowest-seq -> seq4: right o3 only; each wrong on the other two
time-window recency / t-exact-match (outcome.t=160, no decision at 160) -> picks nothing or the wrong extreme
key on outcome.type -> all false_preemption: no origin signal
corroboration-count-only, ignoring key-count -> attacker-key for all (all corrob 0): WRONG o1
count the claimer self-sighting as corroboration -> seq4 corrob 0->1: flips o3 off attacker-key: WRONG o3
length==1 -> attacker-key -> seq4 has 2 inputs (wrong for o3) and seq8 has 1 (attacker for o1, wrong): WRONG
read runtime classification for origin -> all causal decisions LEGITIMATE, origins differ: cannot produce them
